$comment: Engine-wide defaults shared by every channel. Series files can override `length`; channel files set brand/tone. Machine-specific overrides go in engine.config.local.json (gitignored) or .env.

safe_area.$comment: Pixels to keep clear of platform UI on a 1080x1920 frame (strictest of TikTok / Reels / Shorts). All text must stay inside.

llm.$comment: agent = the coding agent operating this repo writes drafts/scripts from task files (free). anthropic = Claude API (paid; needs ANTHROPIC_API_KEY and your OK).

youtube-shorts.ai_disclosure: YouTube Studio > 'Altered or synthetic content'. Required for realistic content; optional (but allowed) for clearly animated content.

tiktok.ai_disclosure: Post settings > 'AI-generated content' toggle. Required when content is significantly AI-generated and realistic.

instagram-reels.ai_disclosure: Advanced settings > 'Add AI label'. Required for photorealistic video or realistic-sounding AI audio.
